title: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
description: A classic Peruvian dish made with beef strips, onions, tomatoes, and French fries, served with rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the French fries and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until they start to brown.
Season with Saltado seasoning and salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with beetroot slices.
Cook rice according to package instructions and serve alongside.
